svg.title: I put a retro arcade on a 14-year-old PC, and yes, I threat-modeled Galaga
svg.desc: A 2012 tower PC with an open side panel exposing a Docker container whose manifest tag is a broken link, a red failure line running from the image registry to the container, and a thin green security loop around the player port. Trace Bloom generative banner for “I put a retro arcade on a 14-year-old PC, and yes, I threat-modeled Galaga”. A isometric lattice probed by 2 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 3180432432.
